The bird features a distinctive crested head with iridescent green and purple plumage, red eyes, and intricate white geometric markings on the face and neck. The body has a chestnut breast, flanks with vertical white stripes, and dark back feathers. The bill is multi-colored with a red base and black tip. The tail is long and pointed, resting just above the water surface.
